notes: 性能优化：单屏截图、历史异步、隐私扫描加速、录屏计时降频、启动更轻。
changelog: 截图只抓当前屏幕，多屏更快更省内存
历史加载与落盘离开主线程，启动更轻
隐私脱敏改用快速 OCR + 缩小图扫描
录屏状态栏计时降为每秒刷新
冷启动延后 ScreenCaptureKit 权限探测
changelogEn: Capture only the active display for faster multi-monitor shots
History load/persist moved off the main thread for snappier launch
Privacy scan uses fast OCR on a downscaled image
Recording status bar updates once per second
Deferred ScreenCaptureKit permission probe after cold start
